jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Generate ONE finished BEAUTIFUL full game scene composition, 16:9 landscape, ideally 1920x1080, not a wireframe and not a contact sheet. This is a vintage occult mechanical gambling card duel, NEON MONTE. All elements together must be art-directed as ONE tactile scene with convincing DEPTH and PERSPECTIVE. References: 1 is the exact finalized ivory/red engraved playing-card aesthetic; 2 provides petrol enamel/brass slot machine materials but its FLAT shape must be radically improved to a deep three-dimensional substantial cabinet; 3 shows the actual three lamp technologies and silhouettes to use as LARGE physical objects, not little icon lights; 4 is a player card portrait. Camera is seated player's view slightly elevated looking down across a generous dark petrol woven tablecloth toward a heavy low wide mechanical cabinet at the BACK of the table. Three large ivory vertical cylindrical reels across the cabinet, with tattoo/woodcut occult symbol illustrations (an idol, toothy mouth, eye mirror), brass dividers and dark curved-away top/bottom shading. Cabinet is a real bulky antique machine: visibly deep TOP deck receding away, visible substantial RIGHT SIDE wall, raised bevels, thick lower plinth, feet firmly on cloth, strong believable contact shadows, painterly light. Do not make a flat rectangular UI frame. Each reel is one expandable module, consistent repeating bay construction; header and side panels are detachable so future 4 or 5 reel versions can expand.
LARGE DISTINCT physical indicator bulbs have their own space IN the housing ABOVE AND BELOW each reel window, not all crowded into one tiny bank. Above each reel put one generous row of 5 LARGE ROUND cranberry glass pilot bulbs with brass sockets; BELOW each reel two well-spaced groups: three tall AMBER torpedo filament bulbs on one side and three squat CYAN gas-discharge tubes with black bakelite bases on the other. Each visible lamp should be at least 28-38 pixels high at 1920 width; generous air between them, consistent technology, alternating on and off for readable contrast. These are real glass lamps with filaments and electrodes. NO heart-, shield-, sword- or icon-shaped lights. No tiny dots or dense pin grids. No textual numbers inside lamps. Leave small physical ivory plaques near rows for later dynamic totals.
A long BRASS LEVER with IVORY BALL is mounted directly to the visible RIGHT SIDE of the cabinet alongside the reels. Its hinge axle runs horizontally parallel to the cylinder axles of the reels, and the lever pulls forward toward the player in a vertical depth plane. Show it upright at rest with a very clearly anchored lateral pivot, believable perspective, not floating.
In the foreground THREE PLAYER CARDS sit on the TABLECLOTH in shallow matching perspective, one directly in front of each reel, ivory faces and red backs with thin black engraved borders, droplet/spear/shield stat glyph columns from first reference, NOT generic tarot redesigns. Faces large enough to identify at a glance but scene beauty and material staging take priority over a giant flat spreadsheet UI. Central card face-down red with three-eye ornament, side cards face-up ivory with illustrative portraits. Visible card edge thickness and shadows; compact hand fan peeking from bottom edge with same cards.
LEFT side: small deck of red-backed cards sitting physically on the cloth, and BELOW the deck a compact ivory inspector slip with just a name and two short text lines, discreet general HP/AP state above it. No permanent huge right sidebar. On RIGHT FOREGROUND table place a large tactile vermilion RED MUSHROOM ATTACK PUSHBUTTON, brass base, rounded cap, generous space to press, consistent perspective with table. Use small tasteful brass/ivory labels only: 'NEON MONTE' on cabinet crown, 'ATTACCA' below mushroom, 'GIRA' near lever, 'LEGENDA' tiny upper right, 'TURNO 04 / 12' discreet top. Legend is closed in this version.
Lighting: warm lamp highlights against moody forest-petrol cloth, red enamel accent, aged brass, ivory paper, restrained wear, antique print/painted collectible illustration, cinematic physical depth. Not sci-fi neon, not vector UI, not flat front elevation, not pixel art, not photorealistic photography. Keep entire cabinet, lever, button, deck, cards within frame; calm hierarchy with heroic cabinet and cards. This is the master composition from which separate production assets will be derived. No annotation arrows, no diagram dimensions, no artist captions.

Edit target image 1, full vintage mechanical card-duel table scene. Reference 2 is finalized card design. Preserve the beautiful cinematic perspective, warm brass/petrol enamel/ivory materials, real cabinet thickness, moody tablecloth, tactile red mushroom button, large distinct round red lamps ABOVE and amber elongated and squat cyan lamps BELOW each of the three reels. Keep the same art direction. Refine composition and clarity as follows. Pull the camera back just enough to show the ENTIRE cabinet top, all feet, entire lever knob, and entire left deck with comfortable margin: no machine parts cut at the top. Make the cabinet's top surface visibly deep and receding away from viewer, increase right side-wall thickness a little, ensure all have a common physically consistent perspective. Frame 16:9. Simplify peripheral clutter: remove the right smoking cup, remove the pen at bottom right, remove coins between deck and cards, remove left bowls; keep just dim room atmosphere and possibly a soft warm illumination source out of frame. Keep table foreground clear and beautiful. Reels must show plain ivory curved mechanical reel paper with just one bold black printed OCCULT SYMBOL per reel: grotesque idol mask, open toothy mouth, eye mirror. Remove ALL playing-card borders, stat drops/spears, faction marks and portrait warrior from the REELS: enemy reels are NOT player cards. Retain beautiful brass reel borders. THREE player cards below remain the finalized ivory/red style: fine engraved border and gocce/lance/scudi on sides, central red back with three eyes, ivory side faces with woodcut portraits; a subtle natural perspective and contact shadow. Left deck should be fully within canvas with a small compact ivory inspector slip BELOW it, not floating; inspector contains only 'DETTAGLIO' and two discreet blank ruled lines for dynamic text, no invented stats. Keep global state a discreet readable physical plaque at top left 'VITA 18 / 24' and 'AP 4 / 5', and 'TURNO 04 / 12' nearby. Text only 'NEON MONTE' on machine crown, 'GIRA' near lever, 'ATTACCA' on mushroom base, 'LEGENDA' top right. Lamp top rows: five spacious big red round bulbs each; bottom groups: three tall amber and three squat cyan each with air gaps, some OFF for contrast. Bulbs should each be visible physical mechanisms, not little flat dots. Keep small EMPTY ivory total plaques near lamps for runtime values. Lever remains mounted directly to right side at reel height with horizontal pivot axle parallel to reel axles. Entire scene with all elements together; no measurement marks, no diagram labels, no split panels.

Extract the EXACT slot-machine cabinet from this full scene as a transparent PNG production asset. Preserve the exact same camera perspective, deep top deck, thick right side, brass feet, enamel petrol material, dimensions/proportions and warm directional lighting. The ONLY object in output is this cabinet. Remove the table, room, cards, deck, mushroom, all UI plaques outside cabinet, and entire lever including knob, shaft, and outside mount. Remove all lamps from upper and lower bays, leaving their EMPTY dark recessed shelves and neutral small mounting sockets. Remove all three reel paper faces/artworks, creating TRUE TRANSPARENT apertures inside the three brass reel windows. Preserve brass frame and dark wells ABOVE and BELOW each window. Remove the lettering NEON MONTE on header plaque, leave ivory plaque blank. Keep all total plaques blank. Cabinet's full thick top and feet visible with transparent margin, tightly framed landscape approximately 2:1. The master has a strong front face with visible top and right depth: do not flatten it. No new parts, no background checkerboard, no tables, no shadows on background, actual transparent alpha. Maintain same design and three identical module construction.

Edit this scene into the EMPTY BACKGROUND PLATE for exactly this game camera. Preserve exact 16:9 framing, viewpoint, lighting, perspective, room, green woven cloth foreground texture, subtle folds and dark vintage atmosphere. REMOVE the entire slot machine, its feet and all cabinet-specific shadow, all cards and deck, inspector slip, attack button and lever, all floating HUD/legend plaques and text. Fill their places with uninterrupted continuous richly tactile dark petrol TABLECLOTH, occupying bottom 80 percent of image, flat usable central playing area. In distant upper edge preserve a softly out-of-focus warm wood room and a low candle glow at far left, kept subdued. Do not add objects in the playable central/right area. Cloth foreshortens into distance with real material depth, near edge larger weave, far edge finer weave. This is a clean background layer, no game controls painted into it, no writing, no symbols, no cards, no cabinet. Do not change camera.

Extract/recreate ONE of the exact ivory mechanical reel drums from the machine in the attached game scene, removing its black printed artwork. Isolate it on true transparent background, square canvas with small padding. Show a broad ivory paper-covered CYLINDRICAL DRUM whose axle runs horizontally left to right. Visible frontal paper surface curls away at top and bottom; strong realistic subtle warm shading top/bottom but broad bright readable ivory center. Thin aged brass cylindrical side end-caps at left and right with rounded corners in projection. Same slightly elevated camera looking at front, physical depth, warm amber scene lighting, antique printed paper fiber. Drum only, no rectangular frame, no lamps, no writing or glyphs, no numeral, no table or scene backdrop. A genuine curved mechanical reel surface, not a flat paper square. Whole object centered fully visible. Original visual design and material fidelity.

EDIT TARGET: image 1, the USER-APPROVED full scene composition. Image 2 is reference for exact finalized printed card art style and symbols. Preserve image 1 camera, framing, perspective, cabinet depth, object positions, dimensions, all three reels, big spaced physical lamps above and below, table, red mushroom button, side-mounted lever, deck and compact inspector. This is a precise STYLE TRANSFER plus small reel-border addition, NOT a redesign of the layout.
1. Make the ENTIRE scene clearly LESS REALISTIC, coordinated with the hand-illustrated vintage cards in image 2: bold clean ink silhouette outlines, engraved/woodcut hatching in controlled shadows, muted petrol enamel and warm aged brass rendered with 3-4 intentional painted color values, restrained screenprint/paper grain, simplified highlights. Remove photographic micro-textures, shiny photoreal gold reflections, realistic bokeh and bloom. Beautiful premium illustrated indie game art, tactile occult vintage print, NOT cartoon comedy, not pixel art, not flat geometric UI. Preserve physically convincing camera perspective, deep top and side of cabinet, card foreshortening and contact shadows. This must still read as a dimensional staged table scene.
2. Add fine elegant BLACK PRINTED BORDERS on the IVORY SURFACE of each reel, inside the brass surround, wrapping with the drum curvature. They match the fine double-line engraved borders of reference cards, but are designed for WIDE horizontal reel faces, not entire copied player-card layouts. Border has a clear large family/suit sign in the top LEFT: left reel SOLAR symbol circle with center dot, middle reel CRESCENT MOON, right reel SATURN astronomical glyph (the exact h-like symbol in reference cards if visible). On the RIGHT border put a short tidy column of 3-4 black rhombic SPEAR ATTACK MARKS matching the card attack glyph, pointed inward, with one small clear total number under it if needed. Leave each bold occult artwork centrally prominent: idol mask, toothy mouth, eye mirror. NO heart or droplet marks, NO health bar, NO HP numbers anywhere on the REEL PAPER: HEALTH IS SHOWN ONLY BY THE LARGE ROUND RED LIGHT BULBS ABOVE. Keep the physical lower amber/cyan bulbs, widely separated, no extra indicator rows.
3. Keep global info panel left as in original, labels NEON MONTE, GIRA, ATTACCA, LEGENDA, DETTAGLIO. Keep same palette with ivory, vermilion-red cards, deep green cloth. Player cards stay finalized style, not redesigned. Keep all elements together at approved positions. No arrows, no dimension guides, no explanatory captions. Single beautiful 16:9 full scene.

Extract ONLY the slot machine cabinet from this illustrated game scene as a production game asset. Preserve exact composition proportions, engraved ink/screenprint NONREALISTIC style, petrol enamel, brass and strong 3D perspective top deck and side depth with feet. Tightly frame the entire cabinet with a modest margin, landscape 2:1. Remove every lamp, reel paper/artwork, all text, lever/knob/mount, and everything else in scene. Three empty TRUE TRANSPARENT reel apertures. Preserve the raised mechanical brass frames, spacious dark upper lamp shelf above each aperture, spacious dark lower shelf below each aperture. Shelves EMPTY with no sockets or pegs; five/ six sockets will be independently placed dynamically. All ivory plaques are BLANK. All cabinet walls/feet remain opaque with bold ink hatching, no realistic photography. Genuine transparent alpha outside cabinet and inside windows. If transparency cannot be represented, use ONLY flat pure white outside/windows, never checkerboard. Cabinet asset only, no background or ground plane, no cast shadow beyond silhouette.

Create empty background layer from attached illustrated game scene. Preserve exact camera, 16:9 composition, rich dark petrol cloth with visible perspective depth, restrained ink hatching and printed grain, black/ochre engraved wood room background, candle and small objects only at far left and far right. REMOVE machine completely, all its lights and lever, all player cards, deck, mushroom button, UI panels, labels and text. Fill removed objects with the continuous tablecloth and room matching perspective. Center must be calm flat usable cloth behind future assets. Keep the style hand-illustrated and clearly NON-photoreal, with limited ink colors and graphic outlines as in source, not realistic bokeh or reflections. A subtly shaded beautifully woven cloth, deep perspective near-to-far, no additional decorative props. Full bleed 16:9 background, no transparency.

Extract/recreate exactly the red mushroom ATTACK button in the lower right of this source as one isolated transparent-background game sprite, square canvas with 12% padding. Match this NONREALISTIC woodcut/ink illustrated style: bold ink contours, short hatching, vermilion red cap with simple cream highlights, engraved aged brass base. Preserve the original camera looking down from front, broad squat circular brass plinth, cap dome and short stem, small rectangular front ivory nameplate. REMOVE writing on nameplate, leave it blank. Fully raised idle state. No surrounding table, no hand, no other objects, no groundplane, no cast shadow beyond object. True alpha outside object. If necessary pure white outside rather than checkerboard. Same shape/design as master scene, no extra screws or arbitrary ornaments.

Extract/recreate exactly the complete LEVER attached to right of cabinet in source, as an isolated transparent-background production sprite on a portrait 1:3 canvas. Include round ivory ball, long narrow golden shaft leaning about 12 degrees to right from bottom to top in its rest pose, and round horizontal brass axle hub at bottom. Axis of hub points right (slightly toward viewer), like a side-mounted slot lever. Preserve camera, perspective and proportions. Bold outlined nonrealistic engraved ink/screenprint art from source, simplified gold shadow planes, no realistic chrome. Nothing from cabinet itself, no surrounding room, no table, no labels, no scene. All parts entirely inside image with 8% transparent padding. Genuine alpha outside object, no checkerboard. This is reference assembly for a 3D-projected lever rig, not a screen-Z animation.
